svc.con.b.1: Is this supplier and compound worth buying?

con.s1.text: Before you place an order, we help you judge whether the ingredient, its form and the supplier behind it are a sensible choice.

con.s2.text: Many problems start with a label, a claim or an ingredient that is not allowed on your target market. We help you catch them early.

con.s2.l.2: Health and nutrition claims: what you can and cannot say

mea.lead: Independent laboratory data on what is actually in a supplement or raw material, so you can compare it with the label and the supplier’s claims.
mea.xrd.title: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD)
mea.xrd.text: XRD gives a fingerprint of the crystalline phases in a powder. It shows which compound and which solid form you really have.
mea.xrd.l.1: Identity: does the pattern match the expected compound?
mea.xrd.l.2: Polymorph and salt or chelate form, for example bisglycinate versus oxide
mea.xrd.l.3: Detection of crystalline adulterants or fillers
mea.hplc.title: HPLC
mea.hplc.text: High-performance liquid chromatography separates and quantifies the components of a sample, so you know how much of the active compound is present.
mea.hplc.l.1: Assay: content of the active compound versus the label claim
mea.hplc.l.4: Method and conditions documented for repeatability
mea.rep.title: Reports
mea.rep.text: Every measurement ends in a written report you can file, share with a supplier or attach to a regulatory dossier.
mea.rep.l.3: Results with a clear comparison to the label or specification
mea.rep.l.4: Raw data and chromatograms or diffractograms attached
mea.how.title: How it works
mea.how.1.x: Tell us what it is and what you need to know: identity, content, purity or all three.
mea.how.2.x: Analysis by XRD, HPLC or both, depending on the question.
mea.how.3.x: Results, raw data and a clear conclusion.
